title: 低销量高库存诊断
context: 仓储经理希望优先处理积压货品。
requirements: 统计2025-10-03至12-31共90日仓库销售出库量；期末为12-31；有效商品、库存价值超过500000分且销量低于20件；无销售记0，库存覆盖天数无销售返回NULL。
commonError: 用内连接会漏掉零销售的积压商品。
executionSteps: 关联期末快照与有效商品
mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold_units,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,ROUND(90.0*i.quantity/NULLIF(s.sold,0),2) cover_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(s.sold,0)<20 ORDER BY stock_value_cents DESC,i.warehouse_id,i.product_id
